main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Ti. Aur. Fu.[?] Bo. Antoninus Pius | 40

page.notes: The first letter of "Quietus" and "Raphael" is a large initial; "Regillianus" continues the R initial on the next line. The number "46" stands on its own line above the Q initial and belongs to "P. Aelius Pertinax". Right-hand numerals are set close to the edge of the page. The large S at the left is a decorative initial shared by the entries Sabina and Salonina. Before "Malatesta" in the first entry there is a decorative flourish, not a letter. "Rossa" is printed with a long-s ligature and is uncertain. The line "Rodulphus II.Imp.295" and "Romanus Diogenes158" are printed without spaces. Entry "Sigismundus Hungaria" is broken with a printed hyphen at the line end. Triuulsius and Fu. in Ti. Aur. Fu. Bo. are doubtful readings. "Zoes foror" is a doubtful reading in the TheodoraZoes entry. The large T and V are initials joined to the following words. No marginal notes.
